That's 1024 validators! Unfortunately, restart might take 2-3 hours... (we have a fix for this, but it is not reviewed and deployed yet.) <@!573787335796326400> could you update us once you guys are in sync? 1000 validators left.. Might be a little while longer - investigating an issue, but on the plus side we'll deploy the fast-start.
